applies_to: CITY MULTI indoor unit groups managed by up to ten G-50A central controllers.
summary: The PAC-YG31CDA is an older Mitsubishi Electric interface that talks to G-50A central controllers over Ethernet and presents each air-conditioner group as a block of BACnet IP objects. Each G-50A and group combination repeats the same template, and the device and notification class instances can be changed in its setting software.
notes: Instance = 6 digits AAGGPP: AA = G-50A number (01-10), GG = group number (01-50), PP = point. Instances here use G-50A 01 / group 01 (e.g. 010101 = 10101).
System Forced Off is AA9921 (one per G-50A); 19921 shown for G-50A 01.
Dry mode and Mid1/Mid2 fan speeds depend on settings and unit type; mode, setpoint and air direction objects depend on the unit model.
Reading Filter Signal Reset returns the same state as Filter Signal.

integration.summary: PAC-YG31CDA is BACnet interface software that runs on a PC and talks to up to ten G-50A controllers over Ethernet. Register the BACnet license in each G-50A, enter each G-50A's number and IP address in the software, then map the per-group objects (AAGGPP).
integration.enable: A BACnet license number must be registered in each G-50A (Ver. 2.50 or later). Local remote-controller lockouts are the 'Prohibition of local operation' BVs (13-16) per group.
setup: Default Device ID 3 (range 1-4194303); the Notification Class also defaults to 3. Both instances can be changed.
BACnet UDP port is fixed at 47808.
Broadcast IP address defaults to 192.168.1.255; APDU timeout 3000 ms, 3 retries, I-Am interval 60 s.
Each G-50A gets a number 1-10 linked to its IP address in the software; that number forms the first two instance digits.
gotchas: The interface is PC software: while the PC is rebooting or a G-50A has failed, control and monitoring may not work. After a power failure the PC must be restarted; a UPS is recommended.
LC (Lossnay) groups treat mode, setpoint and air direction as invalid, and their mode is fixed to ventilation.
Dry mode and Mid1/Mid2 fan speeds only work if enabled in the settings.
